items.summary: Ensure the backend follow/unfollow functions correctly persist the follow relationship between users, storing follower and following associations in stable state, and expose accurate follower/following count queries.

Fix the follow/unfollow button on the UserProfilePage so that tapping it triggers the backend follow/unfollow mutation, shows a loading state during the call, updates the button label (Follow ↔ Following) upon success, and refreshes the displayed follower/following counts immediately after the action.

Wire up the follow/unfollow React Query mutation hooks in useQueries.ts to correctly call the backend actor's follow and unfollow methods, and invalidate the relevant profile and follower count queries on success.
